body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG presented ''KB 1800'' a compact slide mobile TV phone during KES 2006. It has ‘M-XD engine’ for clear broadcasting quality, 170-degree viewing angle, and PC-out that lets users to watch DMB on big screen. Other features include external memory card slot, an electronic dictionary, a text viewer, and a variety of fonts.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
